about: What each building's facade is (task 017, docs/BUILDING-TYPES.md), as a session saw it in its photos: every building in the shooter's area and in view of a viewpoint (node tools/buildings.mjs lists them). By the building's name: way/<id> or relation/<id>, OpenStreetMap's, or lidar/x<x>z<z>, one the map lacks, by the middle of its outline. type, material, ground and balconies are words tools/facades.mjs lists; colour (its walls' above the ground floor), base's colour (the ground floor's, where it isn't the walls') and shutters (the roller shutters', or none) are its colour names. floors: the storeys counted in the photo, the ground floor's among them (null where they couldn't be). signs: the shop signs read in the photo, each its name and its colour. seen: the photo it was looked at in (a reference photo's id, or viewpoint:<id>); sure: false where it was small, far, blurred or half hidden. A building nobody could see in any photo is guessed by tools/world.mjs from the map and from these.

The neighbours: off-white with a balcony on the left, pale pink on the right.

way/440182894.notes: not visible: its outline holds only plants and a railing behind a dark grey sliding gate in the garden wall, in front of the houses.

way/440208498.notes: A one-storey flat-roofed wing in white render at the foot of the block behind it, a row of tall dark-framed windows, the clinic's name and big faces printed on the glass. The photo is backlit, its front in shade.

way/440208499.notes: A low box down the street beside the white block of flats, seen only as a blank, stained greyish rendered wall with a railing round its flat roof; its front faces away. The outline reaches far above it into the sky.

way/440208500.notes: Far behind the ruined old house's corner, at the star: a small white rendered building with a steep gable and two tall dark-framed windows, standing behind a white wall; a white block with glazed balconies rises behind it. way/440209469.notes: The next block along, built to the same design as ★: ochre balcony fronts with glazed or aluminium balustrades on a cream front, four rows of balconies over the ground floor.

way/440209470.notes: Rendered block whose deep concrete slab balconies, sand-coloured, have white railings; on its right a column of balconies glazed in. As viewpoint:travessa-fujacal shows it: Its plain side wall here, in shade, reads a neutral light grey with no yellow at all, cooler than building 1's white tiles and than the cream block behind it in the same light; with fujacal-west showing it near white, it is off-white, not cream.

way/440314417.notes: One of a terrace of alike blocks: pale grey render with deep projecting balcony boxes painted mustard yellow, white railings at their sides; white roller shutters. Shops on the ground floor, one with a square white sign. Dusk light.

way/440314418.notes: A narrow slice at the right edge of a long greyish-beige rendered block over a row of garages (grey-brown doors between pale pilasters, barred vents above); further along the upper floors overhang the street with glazed-in balconies. Top floors out of the frame, the count leans on the LiDAR height.

way/440314419.notes: One garage bay under a long block: grey metal roller door between pale render pillars, the wall above a greenish-khaki grey. The upper floors overhang the street with glazed-in fronts, out of view here, so its storeys can't be counted.

way/440314420.notes: One stretch of a long block along a sloping back lane: a tall plain ground floor with high windows behind curly iron grilles (garage doors further along), shuttered windows above and the top floors cantilevered out over the lane. The cyan cast makes the render read grey; the other views show it beige, with enclosed balconies on the back.

way/440314421.notes: A narrow slice at the near end of the long rendered block along the lane: a tall plain ground floor with a window behind an ornamental iron grille, a window above; further on its upper floors step out over the lane. The top is out of the frame and the photo has a strong blue cast.

way/440314422.notes: A narrow slice of a long block, seen from its back lane under a strong cyan cast: plain pale render, a window with a scrolled iron grille and grey garage doors on the ground floor, the upper floors jutting out over it. Its front on Rua do Fujacal (facade-way-440314423) is warm cream render with projecting yellow-painted balconies with white railings over a shop; five storeys counted there.

way/440314423.notes: One narrow section of a long terrace: greyish beige render, deep projecting balconies with solid parapets painted mustard yellow and white railings, white roller shutters; shops on the ground floor under a dark canopy (a hanging sign says only what one sells). Its outline is a thin strip between drainpipes; the top is out of the frame, so there may be a storey more than the five counted.

way/440314424.notes: A narrow slice of the long rendered block along the lane's right, its back: a tall ground floor of garage doors and small barred windows, the upper floors stepping out over the lane further on. The top is out of the frame; a strong blue cast in the photo (the white garage door looks blue too).

way/440314425.notes: A small mapped piece of the long block: the stack of mustard-ochre balconies over the fruit shop, the upper ones glazed in with aluminium frames, the lowest open with a white railing; the walls behind them pale grey. A green awning over the shop.

way/440314426.notes: Beige render, its front mostly a stack of glazed-in corner balconies whose concrete fronts and top parapet are painted ochre; a fruit shop under a green awning on the ground floor. Its outline is a narrow strip over the middle of it. Blue-tinted windscreen.

way/440314427.notes: Its outline spans the right end of the beige block 2 names (projecting balconies, a glazed-in balcony), a narrow recessed bay of plain beige wall with a drainpipe, and the left edge of the ochre block with glazed-in corner balconies; its 23 m² footprint fits the narrow recessed bay. Frutas Delgado's green awning starts under that bay; the photo is blue-tinted.

way/440314428.notes: A slice of a long block of flats: the plain beige rendered bay with one window per floor (the stair, it seems) and the stack of balconies and glazed-in sun rooms to its right; at least five storeys, the top cut by the frame. Its ground floor is hidden by a lorry; the laundrette and Brilho Necessário signs to its left fall in the next outline.

way/440314429.notes: Part of a long uniform block of pale beige render with deep projecting concrete balconies and white railings; a self-service laundry on the ground floor. The windscreen gives the photo a strong blue cast; the colour is judged against the white shutters.

way/440314430.notes: One bay of a long block of flats in light beige render: concrete-slab balconies with white railings jutting out, white roller shutters, a deep slab over the top floor, shops along the street. The photo's blue cast makes the wall read blue-grey. The outline sits a little left of the shop it's named for; the laundry next door is in 2's.

way/440314431.notes: The left end of the long cream block across the street's end, in shade: concrete slab balconies with white railings, white roller shutters, a slab over the top floor's balconies. Its outline also covers the nearer tiled corner block (dark railings, a dark balcony band) that hides most of it; facade-way-440314429 (#2) shows it plainly.

way/440314432.notes: The same Fujacal terrace: pale render with deep projecting balcony boxes with white railings, white roller shutters, white-shuttered garage doors on the ground floor. Backlit, so the balcony fronts read dark brown; on facade-way-440314417's block, in better light, they are mustard yellow. As viewpoint:fujacal-start shows it: Its ground floor here is flats: windows with sills about a metre up under white roller shutters, a glazed sliding door and a recessed entrance, no garage doors (the white shutters in facade-way-440314432 are these windows'). Backlit, so the wall colour can't be checked.

way/440314433.notes: Boxy projecting balconies with solid ochre (mustard) fronts and white aluminium railings, staggered in pairs up the cream front; four rows of balconies over a ground floor of flats. The LiDAR and OSM say 4 storeys, but 5 can be counted here and in facade-way-440314432.

way/440314434.notes: One bay of a long terrace of blocks: each floor has a deep balcony with a mustard-yellow (ochre) front and white railings; a glazed shopfront below, with no sign readable. The photo's cyan cast makes the cream wall look greenish.

way/440314435.notes: Seen here far off in the gap between houses, in shade: an open balcony over a glazed-in one, a concrete canopy on top. From the street (facade-way-440314436 #3) it's cream render with boxy projecting balconies with mustard-yellow fronts and white railings, over a glazed shop floor. Its outline here also covers a lower cream building to its left.

way/440314436.notes: Part of a long terraced block in cream render with deep projecting balconies, their fronts painted ochre-yellow, staggered from floor to floor; white railings, one balcony glazed in. A glazed shopfront on the ground floor, half behind a street tree; the top is out of frame, five storeys as counted on the same row in facade-way-440314423.

way/440314437.notes: A section of the same Fujacal terrace: pale cream render, deep balconies with mustard-yellow parapets and white railings, the first floor's balcony glazed in with white frames. way/473734204.notes: A narrow terraced building of the 1940s-50s look: pale green render, grey moulded surrounds with small cornices round the windows and the door, a balcony with stone balusters. Overcast and in shade, so the white reads grey.

The photo is dim and cyan-tinted; the gabled building and the flats behind it are others.

Only its left part is in the frame, at the photo's right edge.

way/525872959.notes: A narrow terraced front covered in patterned azulejos, blue on cream, up to a plain concrete parapet. A curved concrete balcony on the top floor and white-railed balconies on the first; barred ground-floor windows. Mid-century in form (roller shutters, slab balconies), though the tiles are old-house style. The photo has a strong yellow-green cast.

way/525872960.notes: A narrow terraced house, its two upper floors stepping out over the street as a bay whose side, seen here, is faced in grey stone slabs; the front is salmon render with tall glazed doors behind white iron railings. way/525872961.notes: Hidden here behind the big conifer and the fence (this is its back). way/525872962.notes: A neglected old terraced house: its ochre paint peeling in big patches to sandy-grey render. Tall wooden windows in moulded surrounds, one iron balcony on a stone slab and a bracketed cornice under the eaves. An azulejo name plaque, 'Vila Palmira', high on the front.

way/525884707.notes: An old industrial building behind the white workshop, its render weathered to sand and grey with cracks and patches, tall window openings filled with vertical concrete louvres, a low-pitched roof of grey sheets; its lower floor hidden by the workshop in front.

way/525884708.notes: A flat-roofed white-rendered garage in a yard, in shade: a wide dark garage opening on its left (shared with 4's stretch of the same white range), a small dark window high up, a door on its side. Half hidden behind a parked van.

way/982804043.notes: Mostly hidden here behind the nearer grey block on the right: only a sliver of its glazed bay between dark green tiled bands. In facade-way-982774306 (#1) and -383766235 (#3) it is a white rendered block with glazed balconies over bands of dark green glazed tiles, white roller shutters, grilled ground-floor windows.

way/982804044.notes: Cream render between white piers, a projecting bay glazed in as an enclosed balcony with parapets of dark-green glazed tiles laid like bricks; white roller shutters. Ordinary windows and an entrance on the ground floor; its top is out of the frame. The same terrace as the grey blocks in facade-lidar-x59z766, here repainted.

way/982804045.notes: White render, stained, with balconies set between projecting pillars, their parapets in dark green brick-pattern tiles. Only the lower floors are in the photo. The ground-floor shop has decorated windows behind bars and a for-sale board. Strong cyan cast.

way/982804046.notes: Weathered white render with grey stained concrete piers; each floor's wide balcony bay glazed in with aluminium windows over a front of dark green glazed tiles. The ground floor, a shopfront of wood-framed glass behind iron grilles, closed. The top floors are out of the frame; cyan cast.

way/982804047.notes: One of a long terrace of identical blocks: deep concrete fins between the bays, white paint peeling to grey concrete, and deep projecting balconies faced in dark-green tiles. Its ground floor a café behind a black iron grille, beside the stair door.

way/982804048.notes: A block in white render with grey-green balcony fronts and white roller shutters, its top out of frame. On its ground floor, the restaurant's row of white awnings, which carry on along the next building. It stands on a paved square with a lawn in front.

way/982804049.notes: A very pale cream render with one white bay, balconies whose parapets are faced in green tiles, white roller shutters; shops on the ground floor, a greengrocer's under a yellow awning. A badly blurred photo cut off above the first floor, so the storeys can't be counted and no sign can be read.

way/982804050.notes: Only its two lowest floors are in frame at the edge: wide dark-framed windows over a band of dark-green panels on a projecting first floor, white render on the pilasters and side walls (the row's other blocks the same, with recessed balconies fronted in dark green); a ground floor of glazed shops between pillars clad in grey stone. Blue-tinted windscreen.

way/982804051.notes: Seen close and from below through a strongly blue-tinted windscreen: white rendered piers and a projecting white bay, with wide windows over solid dark green (teal) spandrel bands running the width of each floor; a ground floor of shopfronts and doors between stone-clad pillars. Its outline and 2's share the same front; the storeys above the second are out of the frame.

way/982804052.notes: The same terrace as the grey blocks beyond it, but renovated like 1 and 2: white render, the projecting bays' parapets clad in dark-green panels. The upper floors overhang a ground floor of pale stone slabs and glass doors; its top is out of the frame.

way/982804053.notes: One of a terrace of identical weathered grey rendered blocks, each storey a projecting bay of white-framed windows over a pale panel, between dark-stained piers. Top out of the frame; in shade.

way/982804054.notes: Same weathered grey block with projecting window bays as 4; a stationer's under a white sign on its ground floor. Top at the frame's edge.

way/982804055.notes: The next of the same grey blocks with projecting window bays, seen at a sharp angle; a small green sign over its ground floor, unreadable.

way/982804056.notes: A thin sliver of the same grey terrace with projecting bays, far down the street.

way/983551344.notes: Down the slope below the street, mostly behind a cypress: the bare grey rendered gable end of the car-repair workshop, a big white sign (Reparações gerais em automóveis) on it and a red roof edge; a small white shed with a red-edged roof to its left. Its taller part with windows is the next way (983551350). A low-sun photo, the wall in shade.

way/983551345.notes: A small two-storey terraced house under a tile roof, its front framed in red paint with an off-white rendered panel on the left and a sand-coloured stone-clad panel on the right; a café's awning (only a coffee brand on it) over the ground floor, mostly hidden by a van. The outline also takes in the older pinkish house with granite surrounds to its left.

way/983551346.notes: A small terraced house in pale pink render (a touch lilac), its windows and door in wide flat surrounds painted grey, a grey band between the floors; a door () and a barred window below, a window with a white roller shutter above. A little azulejo panel of a saint beside the upper window; worn and stained.

way/983551347.notes: A narrow terraced house in yellow render, its windows framed in pale grey with a grey band over the café; the top storey is a glazed-in aluminium gallery under the roof's eaves. A white awning with a red edge over the café. The photo has a cyan cast.

way/983551348.notes: A small old terraced house of two low storeys under a terracotta roof: white render, the windows and door in broad surrounds painted a dusky mauve-brown, roller shutters added in boxes over the windows. In shade; low eaves, as the LiDAR says.

way/983551349.notes: A long, mostly blank side wall painted terracotta red with a white band at first-floor level, a few small windows and a gabled tile roof; the ground floor is hidden by cars and a fence. Plain enough to be an old workshop rather than a house. The signs on it are road direction signs, not its own.

way/983551350.notes: A workshop of bare grey render, three storeys down the slope below the street with small windows in rows (the top ones with white roller shutters), a low pitched roof with a brown edge. The car-repair sign is on its left part, the next way (983551344).

way/983551351.notes: Below the road behind the railing and a stone wall: a car workshop's gable of weathered grey render under a roof with a red-painted edge, a big white board on it reading 'Reparações Gerais em Automóveis'. Mostly hidden by passers-by here; its outline sits right of the gable, but its middle falls on the gable in this photo and in facade-way-983551344 and -349.

way/983551352.notes: Only a grey rendered gable end shows, behind the concrete post with the Camino scallop sign, at the left end of 12's long workshop: perhaps part of it.

way/983551353.notes: Only a sliver at the photo's left edge, in shade: a rendered wall of three or so storeys under a gabled roof's eave, one window. Its outline also spreads over the single-storey white building in front (6), which is another; a low tiled roof and a dark shop window at its foot.

way/983551354.notes: Off-white render framed by dark-green painted bands along the piers, the slab edges and the eaves; stained concrete balconies with dark iron railings and white-framed windows with roller shutters. A butcher's under a dark fascia across the ground floor, its name in red and green letters. Three storeys seen in the steep view; LiDAR's 11.5 m eaves may mean a set-back top floor out of sight.

way/983551355.notes: In deep shade: pale render framed by black-painted bands, a projecting concrete balcony stained with damp and an iron railing, white roller shutters; the ground floor set back under the upper floors as a dark covered space. The top is out of the frame (at least three storeys); the azulejo strips to its left are on the neighbour, 2.

Ground floor of white garage doors with grilles over dark navy tiles, and a cream rendered pillar. Its floors counted in its other photo (facade-way-983551355 #2); here the top is out of frame.

way/983551358.notes: A long low workshop of pale grey render under a shallow pitched roof of sheets with a brown fascia; a row of wide windows high up and a dark rail along the wall.

way/983551359.notes: White relief-patterned tiles with dark grey-green textured panels beside and under the windows; curved projecting balconies with wavy iron railings and brown wooden handrails; the ground floor of grey and white garage doors over a dark blue tiled base. In shade and cyan-tinted; facade-way-983551357 (#3) shows the same.

way/983551360.notes: Down below the road on the right, behind the railing and a passer-by: a long low building of grey render with a flat roof edged in white, only its top storey above the slope.

A blue-green tinted photo; the tiles read bluer in facade-way-983551379.

way/983551372.notes: Panels of small patterned tiles (cream with a pale green pattern) between the windows, with white render on the pillars and the stained concrete balcony slabs. Paired balconies with black wrought-iron railings on each floor; shops shuttered below. In shade, with a cyan cast.

way/983551373.notes: Behind a row of conifers, seen from a bridge: only the tops of a big low shed, a greyish-beige rendered gable end with a shallow roof, and further right a longer pale part under a sheet roof running on to the white warehouse 1. Its outline also takes in a small house on the left.

way/983551374.notes: A tall single-storey warehouse gable end in painted concrete blocks with pilasters, a low-pitched roof of grey sheets, two small windows high up and a big beige sheet-metal door. Behind conifers and shrubs.

way/983551375.notes: Two tall gabled sheds side by side under roofs of sheets: the left one in grimy whitewashed blocks with a big wooden door and two small windows high up, the right one in bare grey concrete blocks with pale grey metal sheets in its gable. Seen across a stream over bushes and young trees.

way/983551376.notes: A tall blank wall of stained grey render behind the car park's railings, a black 'Vegga Home Cozinhas' sign along its top; its outline also takes in the right end of the grey corrugated-metal shed to its left and a low block shed in front. Its other photo (facade-way-983551377 #2) shows the same wall.

way/983551377.notes: A run-down workshop behind a maroon steel fence: stained grey render, a few aluminium windows and a boarded door, graffiti at its right end, a pitched roof of pale metal sheets. Dim and cyan-tinted; the Vegga sign belongs to the shed to its left.

way/983551378.notes: An old industrial block by the riverside path: a stained grey rendered gable under a pitched roof of corrugated sheets, a door up an outside metal stair, no other openings. Its outline also takes the left end of the long white factory (1) and the glazed top floor behind it.

way/983551379.notes: The front is tiled all over in blue-and-white patterned azulejos (a ring motif), with projecting balconies and white wavy iron railings; the ground floor is dark shopfronts. In shade under a blue sky; the top floor is cut off by the photo, the count leans on facade-way-983551380 (#3) and the LiDAR.

way/983551380.notes: Its front all in glazed tiles, white with a grey diamond pattern (a bolder pattern in the balcony recesses), projecting balconies with white iron railings, ochre panels beside some windows; a blue grated door and a white sectional garage door between dark tiled pillars. In facade-way-983551379 the outlines sit one building to the right, on the blue azulejo front next door.

way/983551381.notes: The same white tiles with a grey diamond pattern as the star, under a deep dark eave; projecting balconies with white railings; a small white-fronted shop on the ground floor. Its outline may be one building off (see the star).

way/983551382.notes: A block of the 1960s in deep shade: long balconies with wavy fronts run along each floor behind white iron railings in a zigzag pattern, the walls in off-white ribbed tiles (cream in facade-way-983551383's yellow cast). Shopfronts behind red-painted grilles between pillars in a dark grey checkerboard of tiles. Its upper floors are out of frame (the LiDAR says 5).

way/983551383.notes: Long balconies running along the whole front, curving out between the bays, with ornate white-painted iron railings; panels of small cream-yellow tiles between grey stone piers; the ground floor's piers in a black-and-grey chequered mosaic round red-grilled shop fronts and a garage door. The photo has a strong yellow-green cast; the business's main sign hangs on the neighbour (2), a smaller one on this front in facade-way-983551382.

way/983551384.notes: Panels of speckled grey mosaic between small balconies set in cream-rendered recesses, the balconies with cream-painted railings; a flat roof with a plain parapet. Twin of its left neighbour #2, the downpipe between their ground floors marks the line.

way/983551385.notes: The twin of the ★ to its left, the same speckled grey mosaic, cream recesses and small railed balconies; its ground floor a wide garage door. The outline straddles the line between the two.

way/983551386.notes: A long old factory along the river path: white render, two rows of wide steel-framed windows of many small panes, a couple of round oculi, a pitched terracotta roof. Behind a green mesh fence on a white wall.

way/983551387.notes: Speckled grey-beige rough-cast render like granite chips, its windows in recessed niches lined with small dark mosaic, each with a shallow balconette with white railings. A supermarket's shutter and sign on the ground floor, granite-block pillars. Top out of the frame; floors counted along the terrace in facade-way-983551384, where a set-back top floor shows further on.

way/983551388.notes: Stained white render with vertical strips of blue-green checkered mosaic between windows, and balconies along the front with geometric iron railings. A car showroom below with a black panelled fascia over the glazing; a hipped roof. In shade, with a cyan cast.

way/983551389.notes: The corner of a long block: weathered white render, a balcony along each floor with dark green geometric iron railings, strips of black-and-white patterned mosaic up the front between windows, a hipped tile roof. A tall ground floor of glass in black cladding, the Safelycar car showroom, whose name sits further along under 1.

way/983557832.notes: Seen through a maroon steel fence: a plain grey rendered workshop with a flat roof, a row of small barred windows high up and a few larger windows below; a white wall with a faded painted logo shows at its right end. The photo is dark and blue-tinted.

way/983560328.notes: A single-storey row of shops in front of the 4-storey blocks, white awnings and fascias with red lettering and a green sign, far off in dusk light with a cyan cast. In facade-way-983563072 it shows pale-grey pillars between glazed shopfronts under red signs.

way/984457567.notes: Across the river behind a red footbridge: an open-sided canopy of dark sheets on posts, a small brick-red room with a window at its end, and a white corrugated-metal shed beside it (just right of the outline here; under #2 in facade-way-984457566). A dark, dull photo.
